messages:
Ivy: Posted postmortem for the cache eviction cascade we saw last week. Link: https://notion.redwood/pm/kv-cascade-2024. Root cause summary in the doc.
IncidentBot: Postmortem created by Ivy. Reminder: add remediation owners, timelines, and link actions to the tracker.
Carl: Noted. We should make the playbook machine-friendly: one section for "first 5 min" copy/paste cmds, one for safe-fallback gating, and one for rollback steps.
Neha: I'll own the playbook edits and the PR. Plan: add First-5 checklist, exact commands, and an "expected side effects" blurb so oncall knows the tradeoffs.
Tao: I'll build a small safety-gating library (infra-scripts/gating) so teams can reuse the same preflight checks across services. It will run capacity + error-rate checks and return a structured JSON status.
Ivy: nice. Add a canary rollout note too: prefer progressive fallback (10% -> 50% -> 100%) for high-traffic models.
Liam: Owners: playbook edits -> Neha; gating lib -> Tao; canary plan & runbook text -> Carl; safety validation (staging tests) -> Liam; tracker + follow-up meeting -> Ivy.
Neha: putting due dates in the tracker: PR for runbook by 2024-12-04, gating lib by 2024-11-30, safety tests by 2024-12-02. I'll add the action IDs once created.
Ivy: adding the escalation ladder suggestion: 1) page eng-oncall (PagerDuty) 2) if no ack in 3m escalate to eng-sre 3) if error rate > 4% for 10m -> page infra-leads. Also call out APAC regional owner with 2m ack window.
Carl: copying the commands I used during the incident for the runbook (paste-friendly):
```
# check redis memory + evictions
kubectl -n inference exec svc/cache-inspect -- redis-cli INFO memory | egrep 'used_memory|evicted_keys'
# check cache hitrate (promql)
(sum(rate(cache_hits_total[1m])) by (svc)) / (sum(rate(cache_requests_total[1m])) by (svc))
# check fallback controller status
curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://control.internal/api/v1/fallbacks | jq .mode
# trigger a progressive fallback (wrapper will handle canary increments)
curl -X POST https://control.internal/api/v1/fallbacks/trigger -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"strategy":"progressive","step":10}'
```
Tao: gating lib will expose a CLI and an HTTP shim. Example preflight rules I'll include: spare_capacity_pct >= 10, error_rate_1m <= 0.8, 1m latency_p95 < 250ms. It will return OK/FAIL plus metrics snapshot.
Liam: I'll run safety validation in staging and record the metrics for the playbook doc. Will also test the progressive fallback script for lock contention.
Neha: I'll add a "lint" job in CI that checks playbook structure and required fields (first-5, commands, escalation, owner, action-id). Helps keep docs consistent.
Ivy: tracker: creating action ticket ACTION-4729 and linking to the postmortem. Please reference ACTION-4729 in PRs. Also scheduling a follow-up sync.
IncidentBot: ACTION-4729 created and linked to the postmortem. Follow-up meeting scheduled by Ivy for 2024-12-06 10:00 (invite sent).
Carl: can we add a monthly playbook sweep too? I think a quarterly cadence misses infra churn. Propose 'monthly lightweight check' + 'quarterly in-depth audit'.
Tao: will add a small telemetry check to run weekly that alerts if playbook-required metrics change semantics (e.g., metric name renames).
Liam: after tests I'll post a short summary (pass/fail + notable metrics) to this thread so the follow-up sync has all context.
Neha: once runbook PR is up I'll assign reviewers and update ACTION-4729 with PR link. Plan to merge only after safety tests are green.
Ivy: aim to close the action items within two sprints. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
IncidentBot: Reminder scheduled for 24 hours before follow-up meeting on 2024-12-05.
